## TL;DR

The full `repoos check` passed on source commit `7010c0c50d41cce3e3458cb2db29d434adcd1017`. The macOS Hub QA record and XCTest registry-isolation fix are present. Signed-in Projects and Tasks remain unverified because human-assigned task #1174 has no results.

## Work and rationale

The QA record covers the Hub build and launch, first-run rendering, local server discovery and connection, and the sign-in page. The test run exposed that the XCTest host could write to the developer's real Hub registry. The fix isolates XCTest in a unique temporary support directory, removes it on exit, surfaces cleanup errors, and tests those behaviors.

The QA record explicitly leaves logged-in Projects and Tasks unverified. The current board copy of #1174 remains human-assigned in inbox with no results. No claim is made that this criterion passed.

## Approaches tried

Ran the full `repoos check` once on the current tree. Remote build and test validation passed. Local formatting, lint, build, branch-artifact and task-asset guards passed; rendered contrast and UI smoke also passed. The plan's unrelated or remote-completed steps were skipped as configured.

## Challenges and blockers

The signed-in acceptance check requires the human-assigned #1174 flow: sign in through the authorized email-code process, inspect Projects and Tasks, and record the tested build and results. That task has no results yet. Review also reported an older engineering report for source `2ac8b76`; this draft describes `7010c0c50d41cce3e3458cb2db29d434adcd1017`.

## Key learnings

Showing the sign-in page confirms connection and web-view rendering, not authenticated Projects or Tasks behavior. The report must describe the exact checked tree, and a new draft is needed for each new handoff attempt because RepoOS consumes it when finalizing a report.
